'''2008 New York State Championship Nick Smarcz LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Smarcz]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' A Super Cool Shower with Steve
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
